content.short: Cortex is an AI agent for crypto that executes onchain actions from natural language requests.
content.description: Cortex is an AI agent for crypto research that answers questions about on-chain activity in natural language. A user asks about a market, wallet or protocol and the agent assembles the relevant data instead of the user querying it directly. Its coverage includes Hyperliquid.
content.meta: An AI agent that carries out onchain actions, including sourcing gas on a chain you have just reached.
content.pageTitle: Cortex - DeFi Tools - Lancers Web3 Explorer
